# cpacket-data

Synthetic packet. Generated by `tools/gen/cstruct2pack.py` from
`tools/gen/cstruct/cpacket.json` (run by `tools/gen/cpacket-run.sh`); do not edit by hand.

## Message convention

A message is a DemoPacket header, then its items.

The header is `DemoPacket` up to its last member `data` (8 bytes), little-endian, as the test's config states; `#pragma pack(1)`
is in force where it is declared, so the members follow one another with no padding.
`item_type` (byte 5) selects the kind; `count` (bytes 3-4) counts the items, which follow
the header back to back. On encode the count is the number of items in the list.

## Kinds

| Kind | `item_type` | Constant | Item struct | Item bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wide` | 1 | `kItemWide` | `WideItem` | 5 |
| `narrow` | 2 | `kItemNarrow` | `NarrowItem` | 5 |

The test's config names the item struct of each type.

## Shared-model keys

None: every field is a raw key of module `cpacket`.

## Not mapped, and why

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| Nothing else | synthetic |

## Vectors

`vectors/gen-rt-<kind>.json`: a round trip per kind with two items, values chosen by the
generator and packed by its own serializer from the layouts; `-no-items` has a count of 0.
`gen-err-short` is one byte short of its items, `gen-err-other-id` names no kind.
5 vector files.
